output.title: Three-Bedroom Row House with Private Garden and Parking in Mamer
output.description:
This 1980s row house offers approximately 130 square meters of living space across multiple levels. The residence features three bedrooms and one bathroom, providing comfortable accommodation within a quiet suburban setting. The living room is equipped with patio doors that open onto a garden, allowing natural light to fill the space and offering pleasant views of the outdoor area.

The private rear garden includes a modest lawn area enclosed by a wooden fence, complemented by a small storage shed, ideal for garden equipment or additional storage needs. The property also includes a parking space and a separate cellar, facilitating practical storage solutions and vehicle accommodation.

Located in the commune of Mamer, the setting is a well-established residential area west of Luxembourg City. The neighborhood provides access to schools such as the European School Luxembourg II and Lycée Josy Barthel, as well as convenient motorway and rail connections, supporting easy commuting options.

While the dwelling reflects the style from its original construction period, it offers a well-maintained structure with potential for modernization according to future owner preferences. The small front yard adds to the property's street presence without demanding extensive upkeep.

This residence is well-positioned for those seeking a suburban home within reach of educational institutions and transport infrastructure, combining outdoor space with functional interior layouts.
